old.reported_text: While this document was developed to improve cybersecurity risk management in critical infrastructure, the Framework can be used by organizations in any sector or community.

new.reported_text: February 26, 2024 Preface The Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0 is designed to help organizations of all sizes and sectors — including industry, government, academia, and nonprofit — to manage and reduce their cybersecurity risks.

old.reported_text: The Framework Core consists of five concurrent and continuous Functions—Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, Recover.

new.reported_text: CSF Core structure The CSF Core Functions — GOVERN, IDENTIFY, PROTECT, DETECT, RESPOND, and RECOVER — organize cybersecurity outcomes at their highest level.
